evals.name: safe-parallel-units
evals.prompt: Execute este plano com $orchestrate-implementation. Unit A altera somente docs/api.md; Unit B altera somente docs/cli.md. Não há dependências, interfaces compartilhadas, recursos mutáveis compartilhados ou writes indiretos.
evals.expected_output: Print the concise preflight, create isolated unit worktrees, dispatch both units in parallel, review each unit, and integrate approved commits by deterministic cherry-pick order.
expectations: The preflight is informational and does not request approval.
Both units satisfy all four parallel-safety criteria before dispatch.
Each parallel unit uses its own branch/worktree.
Integration order is deterministic rather than completion-order based.

evals.name: uncertain-parallelism-serializes
evals.prompt: Execute rapidamente com $orchestrate-implementation. Task 1 e Task 2 parecem independentes, mas o plano não informa se ambas atualizam lockfile/codegen.
evals.expected_output: Treat the unknown shared mutable/write-set behavior as uncertainty and execute sequentially rather than proving parallelism through guesswork.
expectations: Uncertainty in any one of the four safety criteria forces sequential execution.
The controller does not invent a write set.

evals.name: unit-review-fix-rounds
evals.prompt: Implemente uma unidade que altera uma migration de banco com $orchestrate-implementation. O primeiro review encontra um bug material; depois do primeiro fix, o re-review ainda encontra um problema material.
evals.expected_output: Round 1 returns to the original implementer. Round 2 uses a new implementer. A material finding after round 2 becomes a blocker.
expectations: The migration makes the unit qualify for its own review under the default risk-based task review.
Round 1 reuses the original implementer.
Round 2 uses a new implementer.
Each re-review is scoped to the previous material findings and the fix range, not the whole unit.
There is no automatic higher-tier model escalation.
The loop is capped at two rounds by default.

evals.name: final-review-fresh-fixers
evals.prompt: Todas as unidades passaram. O review final do $orchestrate-implementation encontra findings materiais cross-cutting e um deles persiste após o primeiro fix.
evals.expected_output: Use a new fixer for final round 1 and another new fixer for final round 2, with validation and re-review after each.
expectations: Final review is enabled by default.
Final findings are not routed back to the original unit implementers by default.
Each final correction round uses a fresh fixer.

evals.name: approved-model-default
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation. O workspace já define modelos concretos configurados pelo usuário para implementer e reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Treat the concrete configured defaults as prior approval, show them in preflight, and continue without a model approval gate.
expectations: Concrete user-configured workspace defaults count as approval.
The controller never uses auto, inherit, omitted, or implicit models.
No repeated model confirmation is requested.

evals.name: missing-model-approval
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation, mas o único model setting disponível é inherit.
evals.expected_output: Do not dispatch any subagent. Suggest a short list of concrete models and request one approval for the missing role.
expectations: inherit is not treated as approved.
No subagent is dispatched before a concrete model is approved.
The controller does not construct a per-task model matrix.

evals.name: default-isolation
evals.prompt: Execute este plano com $orchestrate-implementation a partir da worktree principal. O usuário não pediu execução in-place.
evals.expected_output: Create or obtain an isolated integration worktree, preferring using-git-worktrees when available, then run from there.
expectations: Isolation is the default.
The default/main worktree is not used for implementation implicitly.
using-git-worktrees is preferred when available.

evals.name: task-grouping-and-splitting
evals.prompt: O plano tem duas tasks minúsculas da mesma mudança e uma terceira task grande com duas partes independentes. Execute com $orchestrate-implementation.
evals.expected_output: Group the small related tasks into one unit by default and split the large task only because its parts are independent, preserving a mapping to original tasks/requirements.
expectations: Plan task boundaries do not have to equal dispatch boundaries; grouping small related tasks is the default.
Traceability to source tasks/requirements is preserved.
Review follows the execution unit.

evals.name: integration-conflict-fallback
evals.prompt: Duas unidades foram consideradas seguras para paralelo. A segunda gera conflito material no cherry-pick para a integração.
evals.expected_output: Abort that cherry-pick, keep prior successful integrations, invalidate the independence assumption for the affected unit, and re-run it sequentially from the current integration head.
expectations: The controller does not resolve the material conflict inside the parallel wave.
The affected unit is re-executed sequentially.
Already integrated successful work is preserved.

evals.name: no-automatic-publication
evals.prompt: Conclua o plano com $orchestrate-implementation. O usuário não pediu merge, push ou PR.
evals.expected_output: Finish with a ready, validated, reviewed branch/worktree and a concise summary, without merging, pushing, creating a PR, or removing the worktree.
expectations: The branch/worktree is left ready for the user.
No publication/integration side effect happens without explicit request.

evals.name: risk-based-review-skips-low-risk
evals.prompt: Execute com $orchestrate-implementation um plano de 6 tasks: cinco ajustes pequenos de UI/docs e uma task que altera a checagem de permissões. O usuário não configurou task_review.
evals.expected_output: Group the small tasks into few units, review only the permissions unit individually, and rely on the final review for the low-risk units.
expectations: The run uses far fewer units than plan tasks.
Only the high-risk (permissions) unit gets its own review.
Low-risk units are not reviewed individually but are covered by the final review.
The preflight shows which units are reviewed.

evals.name: validation-evidence-not-rerun
evals.prompt: Um implementer do $orchestrate-implementation reporta DONE com os comandos de validação focada, exit 0 e os commits criados. Nada no diff contradiz o relato.
evals.expected_output: Verify the reported evidence and commits in Git and move on without re-running the focused validations.
expectations: The controller does not re-run focused validations when evidence is complete and consistent.
The controller would re-run a check only if evidence were missing, ambiguous, or contradicted by the diff.
Full validation still runs once after integration.
